name: miro
description: Connect Miro to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Miro MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Miro to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with boards, diagrams and docs using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Miro workspace.
Find anything in Miro that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review boards, diagrams and docs in Miro.
